function.name: intend_create_hold
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Create a temporary room-type booking at the resource property. Give exact dates, guest, plan, occupants, new reservation ID and hold_minutes (15/30/60). Every night must have capacity.

function.name: intend_capture_payment
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Simulate an integer-cent payment on the reservation. card_approved succeeds and card_declined fails. Same key/value retry is idempotent.

function.name: intend_confirm_reservation
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Confirm a valid unexpired hold after its quoted deposit is successfully paid.

function.name: intend_release_hold
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.name: intend_expire_hold
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.name: intend_change_dates
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Revalidate the entire new interval, release old room assignment and return the booking to a repriced hold requiring reconfirmation.

function.name: intend_change_room_type
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Upgrade/downgrade an unoccupied booking to a permitted type/plan, revalidate all nights, release the room and return to a repriced hold.

function.name: intend_assign_room
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: intend_unassign_room
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.name: intend_cancel_reservation
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: intend_refund_reservation
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.name: intend_mark_room_clean
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Housekeeping or manager marks an unoccupied room clean. An occupied room cannot be cleaned through this operation.

function.name: intend_set_room_maintenance
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Manager locks/unlocks a room for maintenance. Locking cannot invalidate existing assignments or room-type bookings.

function.name: intend_check_in
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Front desk/manager checks in a confirmed booking within its dates, with room assignment, full payment and independent guest identity verification.

function.name: intend_swap_room
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Atomically move a checked-in stay to another clean available room of the same type/property; release old occupancy, dirty old room, update assignment and stay.

function.name: intend_check_out
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Check out an occupied stay, release assignment/date inventory, clear current room stay and mark the room dirty.

function.name: intend_change_calendar_limit
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Manager changes the sale limit of a resource calendar-day ID, bounded by physical type rooms and existing bookings.

function.name: intend_set_calendar_closed
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Manager closes/opens one calendar-day ID; closing is forbidden while that night has bookings or holds.

function.name: intend_verify_guest
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Front desk asks the independent identity simulator to verify the reservation guest. Do not supply an identity outcome or external attestation.

function.name: ask_service
function.description: Ask a question or discuss a request without granting any write.

function.name: stop_exploration
function.description: Voluntarily end exploration; no business operation occurs.

function.name: intend_create_hold
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Create a temporary room-type booking at the resource property. Give exact dates, guest, plan, occupants, new reservation ID and hold_minutes (15/30/60). Every night must have capacity.

function.name: intend_capture_payment
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Simulate an integer-cent payment on the reservation. card_approved succeeds and card_declined fails. Same key/value retry is idempotent.

function.name: intend_confirm_reservation
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Confirm a valid unexpired hold after its quoted deposit is successfully paid.

function.name: intend_release_hold
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.name: intend_expire_hold
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.name: intend_change_dates
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Revalidate the entire new interval, release old room assignment and return the booking to a repriced hold requiring reconfirmation.

function.name: intend_change_room_type
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Upgrade/downgrade an unoccupied booking to a permitted type/plan, revalidate all nights, release the room and return to a repriced hold.

function.name: intend_assign_room
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: intend_unassign_room
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.name: intend_cancel_reservation
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: intend_refund_reservation
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.name: intend_mark_room_clean
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Housekeeping or manager marks an unoccupied room clean. An occupied room cannot be cleaned through this operation.

function.name: intend_set_room_maintenance
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Manager locks/unlocks a room for maintenance. Locking cannot invalidate existing assignments or room-type bookings.

function.name: intend_check_in
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Front desk/manager checks in a confirmed booking within its dates, with room assignment, full payment and independent guest identity verification.

function.name: intend_swap_room
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Atomically move a checked-in stay to another clean available room of the same type/property; release old occupancy, dirty old room, update assignment and stay.

function.name: intend_check_out
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Check out an occupied stay, release assignment/date inventory, clear current room stay and mark the room dirty.

function.name: intend_change_calendar_limit
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Manager changes the sale limit of a resource calendar-day ID, bounded by physical type rooms and existing bookings.

function.name: intend_set_calendar_closed
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Manager closes/opens one calendar-day ID; closing is forbidden while that night has bookings or holds.

function.name: intend_verify_guest
function.description: Declare an exact customer intention before Service acts. Front desk asks the independent identity simulator to verify the reservation guest. Do not supply an identity outcome or external attestation.

function.name: ask_service
function.description: Ask a question or discuss a request without granting any write.

function.name: stop_exploration

function.description: Simulate an integer-cent payment on the reservation. card_approved succeeds and card_declined fails. Same key/value retry is idempotent.

function.name: confirm_reservation
function.description: Confirm a valid unexpired hold after its quoted deposit is successfully paid.

function.name: release_hold
function.description: Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.name: expire_hold
function.description: Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.name: change_dates
function.description: Revalidate the entire new interval, release old room assignment and return the booking to a repriced hold requiring reconfirmation.

function.name: change_room_type
function.description: Upgrade/downgrade an unoccupied booking to a permitted type/plan, revalidate all nights, release the room and return to a repriced hold.

function.name: assign_room
function.description: Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: unassign_room
function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description: Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: refund_reservation
function.description: Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.name: mark_room_clean
function.description: Housekeeping or manager marks an unoccupied room clean. An occupied room cannot be cleaned through this operation.

function.name: set_room_maintenance
function.description: Manager locks/unlocks a room for maintenance. Locking cannot invalidate existing assignments or room-type bookings.

function.name: check_in
function.description: Front desk/manager checks in a confirmed booking within its dates, with room assignment, full payment and independent guest identity verification.

function.name: swap_room
function.description: Atomically move a checked-in stay to another clean available room of the same type/property; release old occupancy, dirty old room, update assignment and stay.

function.name: check_out
function.description: Check out an occupied stay, release assignment/date inventory, clear current room stay and mark the room dirty.

function.name: change_calendar_limit
function.description: Manager changes the sale limit of a resource calendar-day ID, bounded by physical type rooms and existing bookings.

function.name: set_calendar_closed
function.description: Manager closes/opens one calendar-day ID; closing is forbidden while that night has bookings or holds.

function.name: verify_guest

function.name: get_property

function.name: get_availability

function.name: get_room

function.name: create_hold
function.description: Create a temporary room-type booking at the resource property. Give exact dates, guest, plan, occupants, new reservation ID and hold_minutes (15/30/60). Every night must have capacity.

function.name: capture_payment
function.description: Simulate an integer-cent payment on the reservation. card_approved succeeds and card_declined fails. Same key/value retry is idempotent.

function.name: confirm_reservation
function.description: Confirm a valid unexpired hold after its quoted deposit is successfully paid.

function.name: release_hold
function.description: Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.name: expire_hold
function.description: Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.name: change_dates
function.description: Revalidate the entire new interval, release old room assignment and return the booking to a repriced hold requiring reconfirmation.

function.name: change_room_type
function.description: Upgrade/downgrade an unoccupied booking to a permitted type/plan, revalidate all nights, release the room and return to a repriced hold.

function.name: assign_room
function.description: Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: unassign_room
function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description: Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: refund_reservation
function.description: Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.name: mark_room_clean
function.description: Housekeeping or manager marks an unoccupied room clean. An occupied room cannot be cleaned through this operation.

function.name: set_room_maintenance
function.description: Manager locks/unlocks a room for maintenance. Locking cannot invalidate existing assignments or room-type bookings.

function.name: check_in
function.description: Front desk/manager checks in a confirmed booking within its dates, with room assignment, full payment and independent guest identity verification.

function.name: swap_room
function.description: Atomically move a checked-in stay to another clean available room of the same type/property; release old occupancy, dirty old room, update assignment and stay.

function.name: check_out
function.description: Check out an occupied stay, release assignment/date inventory, clear current room stay and mark the room dirty.

function.name: change_calendar_limit
function.description: Manager changes the sale limit of a resource calendar-day ID, bounded by physical type rooms and existing bookings.

function.name: set_calendar_closed
function.description: Manager closes/opens one calendar-day ID; closing is forbidden while that night has bookings or holds.

function.name: verify_guest
function.description: Front desk asks the independent identity simulator to verify the reservation guest. Do not supply an identity outcome or external attestation.

function.name: get_property
function.description: Query public property policy and configuration.

function.name: get_availability
function.description: Query public per-night capacity, held/booked counts and available inventory for the property/type/date interval.

function.name: get_room
function.description: Query scoped staff room state; a guest assigned here sees public room identification only.

function.name: get_reservation
function.description: Query a permitted reservation, quote, payments, current assignment and observed verification status.

function.name: get_guest
function.description: Query a permitted guest profile without private simulator fixtures or other booking records.

function.name: get_payment_ledger
function.description: Finance/manager or owning guest queries payments, actual balance, deposit and refundable amount.

function.name: get_calendar_day
function.description: Staff query one scoped date inventory control.

function.name: get_rate_plan
function.description: Query public deposit and cancellation policy for a property rate plan.

function.name: get_customer_context
function.description: Discover public property catalog and scoped room, guest, reservation and financial records for the fixed identity.

function.name: create_hold

function.name: confirm_reservation
function.description: Confirm a valid unexpired hold after its quoted deposit is successfully paid.

function.name: release_hold
function.description: Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.name: expire_hold
function.description: Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.name: change_dates
function.description: Revalidate the entire new interval, release old room assignment and return the booking to a repriced hold requiring reconfirmation.

function.name: change_room_type
function.description: Upgrade/downgrade an unoccupied booking to a permitted type/plan, revalidate all nights, release the room and return to a repriced hold.

function.name: assign_room
function.description: Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: unassign_room
function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description: Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: refund_reservation

function.name: set_room_maintenance

function.name: check_in
function.description: Front desk/manager checks in a confirmed booking within its dates, with room assignment, full payment and independent guest identity verification.

function.name: swap_room

function.name: check_out

function.name: change_calendar_limit

function.name: set_calendar_closed

function.name: create_hold
function.description: Create a temporary room-type booking at the resource property. Give exact dates, guest, plan, occupants, new reservation ID and hold_minutes (15/30/60). Every night must have capacity.

function.name: capture_payment
function.description: Simulate an integer-cent payment on the reservation. card_approved succeeds and card_declined fails. Same key/value retry is idempotent.

function.name: confirm_reservation
function.description: Confirm a valid unexpired hold after its quoted deposit is successfully paid.

function.name: release_hold
function.description: Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.name: expire_hold
function.description: Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.name: change_dates
function.description: Revalidate the entire new interval, release old room assignment and return the booking to a repriced hold requiring reconfirmation.

function.name: change_room_type
function.description: Upgrade/downgrade an unoccupied booking to a permitted type/plan, revalidate all nights, release the room and return to a repriced hold.

function.name: assign_room
function.description: Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: unassign_room
function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description: Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: refund_reservation
function.description: Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.name: mark_room_clean
function.description: Housekeeping or manager marks an unoccupied room clean. An occupied room cannot be cleaned through this operation.

function.name: set_room_maintenance
function.description: Manager locks/unlocks a room for maintenance. Locking cannot invalidate existing assignments or room-type bookings.

function.name: check_in
function.description: Front desk/manager checks in a confirmed booking within its dates, with room assignment, full payment and independent guest identity verification.

function.name: swap_room
function.description: Atomically move a checked-in stay to another clean available room of the same type/property; release old occupancy, dirty old room, update assignment and stay.

function.name: check_out
function.description: Check out an occupied stay, release assignment/date inventory, clear current room stay and mark the room dirty.

function.name: change_calendar_limit
function.description: Manager changes the sale limit of a resource calendar-day ID, bounded by physical type rooms and existing bookings.

function.name: set_calendar_closed
function.description: Manager closes/opens one calendar-day ID; closing is forbidden while that night has bookings or holds.

function.name: verify_guest
function.description: Front desk asks the independent identity simulator to verify the reservation guest. Do not supply an identity outcome or external attestation.

function.name: get_property
function.description: Query public property policy and configuration.

function.name: get_availability
function.description: Query public per-night capacity, held/booked counts and available inventory for the property/type/date interval.

function.name: get_room
function.description: Query scoped staff room state; a guest assigned here sees public room identification only.

function.name: get_reservation
function.description: Query a permitted reservation, quote, payments, current assignment and observed verification status.

function.name: get_guest
function.description: Query a permitted guest profile without private simulator fixtures or other booking records.

function.name: get_payment_ledger
function.description: Finance/manager or owning guest queries payments, actual balance, deposit and refundable amount.

function.name: get_calendar_day
function.description: Staff query one scoped date inventory control.

function.name: get_rate_plan
function.description: Query public deposit and cancellation policy for a property rate plan.

function.name: get_customer_context
function.description: Discover public property catalog and scoped room, guest, reservation and financial records for the fixed identity.

function.name: create_hold
function.description: Create a temporary room-type booking at the resource property. Give exact dates, guest, plan, occupants, new reservation ID and hold_minutes (15/30/60). Every night must have capacity.

function.name: capture_payment
function.description: Simulate an integer-cent payment on the reservation. card_approved succeeds and card_declined fails. Same key/value retry is idempotent.

function.name: confirm_reservation
function.description: Confirm a valid unexpired hold after its quoted deposit is successfully paid.

function.name: release_hold
function.description: Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.name: expire_hold
function.description: Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.name: change_dates
function.description: Revalidate the entire new interval, release old room assignment and return the booking to a repriced hold requiring reconfirmation.

function.name: change_room_type
function.description: Upgrade/downgrade an unoccupied booking to a permitted type/plan, revalidate all nights, release the room and return to a repriced hold.

function.name: assign_room
function.description: Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: unassign_room
function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description: Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: refund_reservation
function.description: Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.name: mark_room_clean
function.description: Housekeeping or manager marks an unoccupied room clean. An occupied room cannot be cleaned through this operation.

function.name: set_room_maintenance
function.description: Manager locks/unlocks a room for maintenance. Locking cannot invalidate existing assignments or room-type bookings.

function.name: check_in
function.description: Front desk/manager checks in a confirmed booking within its dates, with room assignment, full payment and independent guest identity verification.

function.name: swap_room
function.description: Atomically move a checked-in stay to another clean available room of the same type/property; release old occupancy, dirty old room, update assignment and stay.

function.name: check_out
function.description: Check out an occupied stay, release assignment/date inventory, clear current room stay and mark the room dirty.

function.name: change_calendar_limit
function.description: Manager changes the sale limit of a resource calendar-day ID, bounded by physical type rooms and existing bookings.

function.name: set_calendar_closed
function.description: Manager closes/opens one calendar-day ID; closing is forbidden while that night has bookings or holds.

function.name: verify_guest
function.description: Front desk asks the independent identity simulator to verify the reservation guest. Do not supply an identity outcome or external attestation.

function.name: get_property
function.description: Query public property policy and configuration.

function.name: get_availability
function.description: Query public per-night capacity, held/booked counts and available inventory for the property/type/date interval.

function.name: get_room
function.description: Query scoped staff room state; a guest assigned here sees public room identification only.

function.name: get_reservation
function.description: Query a permitted reservation, quote, payments, current assignment and observed verification status.

function.name: get_guest
function.description: Query a permitted guest profile without private simulator fixtures or other booking records.

function.name: get_payment_ledger
function.description: Finance/manager or owning guest queries payments, actual balance, deposit and refundable amount.

function.name: get_calendar_day
function.description: Staff query one scoped date inventory control.

function.name: get_rate_plan
function.description: Query public deposit and cancellation policy for a property rate plan.

function.name: get_customer_context
function.description: Discover public property catalog and scoped room, guest, reservation and financial records for the fixed identity.

function.description: Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.description: Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: unassign_room
function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.description: Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: refund_reservation
function.description: Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.name: check_out
function.description: Check out an occupied stay, release assignment/date inventory, clear current room stay and mark the room dirty.

function.name: change_calendar_limit

function.name: create_hold
function.description: Create a temporary room-type booking at the resource property. Give exact dates, guest, plan, occupants, new reservation ID and hold_minutes (15/30/60). Every night must have capacity.

function.name: capture_payment
function.description: Simulate an integer-cent payment on the reservation. card_approved succeeds and card_declined fails. Same key/value retry is idempotent.

function.name: confirm_reservation
function.description: Confirm a valid unexpired hold after its quoted deposit is successfully paid.

function.name: release_hold
function.description: Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.name: expire_hold
function.description: Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.name: change_dates
function.description: Revalidate the entire new interval, release old room assignment and return the booking to a repriced hold requiring reconfirmation.

function.name: change_room_type
function.description: Upgrade/downgrade an unoccupied booking to a permitted type/plan, revalidate all nights, release the room and return to a repriced hold.

function.name: assign_room
function.description: Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: unassign_room
function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description: Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: refund_reservation
function.description: Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.name: mark_room_clean
function.description: Housekeeping or manager marks an unoccupied room clean. An occupied room cannot be cleaned through this operation.

function.name: set_room_maintenance
function.description: Manager locks/unlocks a room for maintenance. Locking cannot invalidate existing assignments or room-type bookings.

function.name: check_in
function.description: Front desk/manager checks in a confirmed booking within its dates, with room assignment, full payment and independent guest identity verification.

function.name: swap_room
function.description: Atomically move a checked-in stay to another clean available room of the same type/property; release old occupancy, dirty old room, update assignment and stay.

function.name: check_out
function.description: Check out an occupied stay, release assignment/date inventory, clear current room stay and mark the room dirty.

function.name: change_calendar_limit
function.description: Manager changes the sale limit of a resource calendar-day ID, bounded by physical type rooms and existing bookings.

function.name: set_calendar_closed
function.description: Manager closes/opens one calendar-day ID; closing is forbidden while that night has bookings or holds.

function.name: verify_guest
function.description: Front desk asks the independent identity simulator to verify the reservation guest. Do not supply an identity outcome or external attestation.

function.name: get_property
function.description: Query public property policy and configuration.

function.name: get_availability
function.description: Query public per-night capacity, held/booked counts and available inventory for the property/type/date interval.

function.name: get_room
function.description: Query scoped staff room state; a guest assigned here sees public room identification only.

function.name: get_reservation
function.description: Query a permitted reservation, quote, payments, current assignment and observed verification status.

function.name: get_guest
function.description: Query a permitted guest profile without private simulator fixtures or other booking records.

function.name: get_payment_ledger
function.description: Finance/manager or owning guest queries payments, actual balance, deposit and refundable amount.

function.name: get_calendar_day
function.description: Staff query one scoped date inventory control.

function.name: get_rate_plan
function.description: Query public deposit and cancellation policy for a property rate plan.

function.name: get_customer_context
function.description: Discover public property catalog and scoped room, guest, reservation and financial records for the fixed identity.

function.description: Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.description: Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.description: Revalidate the entire new interval, release old room assignment and return the booking to a repriced hold requiring reconfirmation.

function.description: Upgrade/downgrade an unoccupied booking to a permitted type/plan, revalidate all nights, release the room and return to a repriced hold.

function.description: Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: unassign_room
function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.description: Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.description: Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.description: Front desk/manager checks in a confirmed booking within its dates, with room assignment, full payment and independent guest identity verification.

function.name: swap_room

function.name: check_out

function.name: change_calendar_limit

function.name: create_hold
function.description: Create a temporary room-type booking at the resource property. Give exact dates, guest, plan, occupants, new reservation ID and hold_minutes (15/30/60). Every night must have capacity.

function.name: capture_payment
function.description: Simulate an integer-cent payment on the reservation. card_approved succeeds and card_declined fails. Same key/value retry is idempotent.

function.name: confirm_reservation
function.description: Confirm a valid unexpired hold after its quoted deposit is successfully paid.

function.name: release_hold
function.description: Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.name: expire_hold
function.description: Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.name: change_dates
function.description: Revalidate the entire new interval, release old room assignment and return the booking to a repriced hold requiring reconfirmation.

function.name: change_room_type
function.description: Upgrade/downgrade an unoccupied booking to a permitted type/plan, revalidate all nights, release the room and return to a repriced hold.

function.name: assign_room
function.description: Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: unassign_room
function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description: Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: refund_reservation
function.description: Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.name: mark_room_clean
function.description: Housekeeping or manager marks an unoccupied room clean. An occupied room cannot be cleaned through this operation.

function.name: set_room_maintenance
function.description: Manager locks/unlocks a room for maintenance. Locking cannot invalidate existing assignments or room-type bookings.

function.name: check_in
function.description: Front desk/manager checks in a confirmed booking within its dates, with room assignment, full payment and independent guest identity verification.

function.name: swap_room
function.description: Atomically move a checked-in stay to another clean available room of the same type/property; release old occupancy, dirty old room, update assignment and stay.

function.name: check_out
function.description: Check out an occupied stay, release assignment/date inventory, clear current room stay and mark the room dirty.

function.name: change_calendar_limit
function.description: Manager changes the sale limit of a resource calendar-day ID, bounded by physical type rooms and existing bookings.

function.name: set_calendar_closed
function.description: Manager closes/opens one calendar-day ID; closing is forbidden while that night has bookings or holds.

function.name: verify_guest
function.description: Front desk asks the independent identity simulator to verify the reservation guest. Do not supply an identity outcome or external attestation.

function.name: get_property
function.description: Query public property policy and configuration.

function.name: get_availability
function.description: Query public per-night capacity, held/booked counts and available inventory for the property/type/date interval.

function.name: get_room
function.description: Query scoped staff room state; a guest assigned here sees public room identification only.

function.name: get_reservation
function.description: Query a permitted reservation, quote, payments, current assignment and observed verification status.

function.name: get_guest
function.description: Query a permitted guest profile without private simulator fixtures or other booking records.

function.name: get_payment_ledger

function.name: get_calendar_day

function.name: get_rate_plan

function.name: create_hold
function.description: Create a temporary room-type booking at the resource property. Give exact dates, guest, plan, occupants, new reservation ID and hold_minutes (15/30/60). Every night must have capacity.

function.name: capture_payment
function.description: Simulate an integer-cent payment on the reservation. card_approved succeeds and card_declined fails. Same key/value retry is idempotent.

function.name: confirm_reservation
function.description: Confirm a valid unexpired hold after its quoted deposit is successfully paid.

function.name: release_hold
function.description: Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.name: expire_hold
function.description: Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.name: change_dates
function.description: Revalidate the entire new interval, release old room assignment and return the booking to a repriced hold requiring reconfirmation.

function.name: change_room_type
function.description: Upgrade/downgrade an unoccupied booking to a permitted type/plan, revalidate all nights, release the room and return to a repriced hold.

function.name: assign_room
function.description: Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: unassign_room
function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description: Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: refund_reservation
function.description: Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.name: mark_room_clean
function.description: Housekeeping or manager marks an unoccupied room clean. An occupied room cannot be cleaned through this operation.

function.name: set_room_maintenance
function.description: Manager locks/unlocks a room for maintenance. Locking cannot invalidate existing assignments or room-type bookings.

function.name: check_in
function.description: Front desk/manager checks in a confirmed booking within its dates, with room assignment, full payment and independent guest identity verification.

function.name: swap_room
function.description: Atomically move a checked-in stay to another clean available room of the same type/property; release old occupancy, dirty old room, update assignment and stay.

function.name: check_out
function.description: Check out an occupied stay, release assignment/date inventory, clear current room stay and mark the room dirty.

function.name: change_calendar_limit
function.description: Manager changes the sale limit of a resource calendar-day ID, bounded by physical type rooms and existing bookings.

function.name: set_calendar_closed
function.description: Manager closes/opens one calendar-day ID; closing is forbidden while that night has bookings or holds.

function.name: verify_guest
function.description: Front desk asks the independent identity simulator to verify the reservation guest. Do not supply an identity outcome or external attestation.

function.name: get_property
function.description: Query public property policy and configuration.

function.name: get_availability
function.description: Query public per-night capacity, held/booked counts and available inventory for the property/type/date interval.

function.name: get_room
function.description: Query scoped staff room state; a guest assigned here sees public room identification only.

function.name: get_reservation
function.description: Query a permitted reservation, quote, payments, current assignment and observed verification status.

function.name: get_guest
function.description: Query a permitted guest profile without private simulator fixtures or other booking records.

function.name: get_payment_ledger
function.description: Finance/manager or owning guest queries payments, actual balance, deposit and refundable amount.

function.name: get_calendar_day
function.description: Staff query one scoped date inventory control.

function.name: get_rate_plan
function.description: Query public deposit and cancellation policy for a property rate plan.

function.name: get_customer_context
function.description: Discover public property catalog and scoped room, guest, reservation and financial records for the fixed identity.

function.name: create_hold
function.description: Create a temporary room-type booking at the resource property. Give exact dates, guest, plan, occupants, new reservation ID and hold_minutes (15/30/60). Every night must have capacity.

function.name: capture_payment
function.description: Simulate an integer-cent payment on the reservation. card_approved succeeds and card_declined fails. Same key/value retry is idempotent.

function.name: confirm_reservation
function.description: Confirm a valid unexpired hold after its quoted deposit is successfully paid.

function.name: release_hold
function.description: Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.name: expire_hold
function.description: Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.name: change_dates
function.description: Revalidate the entire new interval, release old room assignment and return the booking to a repriced hold requiring reconfirmation.

function.name: change_room_type
function.description: Upgrade/downgrade an unoccupied booking to a permitted type/plan, revalidate all nights, release the room and return to a repriced hold.

function.name: assign_room
function.description: Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: unassign_room
function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description: Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: refund_reservation
function.description: Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.name: mark_room_clean
function.description: Housekeeping or manager marks an unoccupied room clean. An occupied room cannot be cleaned through this operation.

function.name: set_room_maintenance
function.description: Manager locks/unlocks a room for maintenance. Locking cannot invalidate existing assignments or room-type bookings.

function.name: check_in
function.description: Front desk/manager checks in a confirmed booking within its dates, with room assignment, full payment and independent guest identity verification.

function.name: swap_room
function.description: Atomically move a checked-in stay to another clean available room of the same type/property; release old occupancy, dirty old room, update assignment and stay.

function.name: check_out
function.description: Check out an occupied stay, release assignment/date inventory, clear current room stay and mark the room dirty.

function.name: change_calendar_limit
function.description: Manager changes the sale limit of a resource calendar-day ID, bounded by physical type rooms and existing bookings.

function.name: set_calendar_closed
function.description: Manager closes/opens one calendar-day ID; closing is forbidden while that night has bookings or holds.

function.name: verify_guest
function.description: Front desk asks the independent identity simulator to verify the reservation guest. Do not supply an identity outcome or external attestation.

function.name: get_property
function.description: Query public property policy and configuration.

function.name: get_availability
function.description: Query public per-night capacity, held/booked counts and available inventory for the property/type/date interval.

function.name: get_room
function.description: Query scoped staff room state; a guest assigned here sees public room identification only.

function.name: get_reservation
function.description: Query a permitted reservation, quote, payments, current assignment and observed verification status.

function.name: get_guest
function.description: Query a permitted guest profile without private simulator fixtures or other booking records.

function.name: create_hold
function.description: Create a temporary room-type booking at the resource property. Give exact dates, guest, plan, occupants, new reservation ID and hold_minutes (15/30/60). Every night must have capacity.

function.name: capture_payment
function.description: Simulate an integer-cent payment on the reservation. card_approved succeeds and card_declined fails. Same key/value retry is idempotent.

function.name: confirm_reservation
function.description: Confirm a valid unexpired hold after its quoted deposit is successfully paid.

function.name: release_hold
function.description: Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.name: expire_hold
function.description: Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.name: change_dates
function.description: Revalidate the entire new interval, release old room assignment and return the booking to a repriced hold requiring reconfirmation.

function.name: change_room_type
function.description: Upgrade/downgrade an unoccupied booking to a permitted type/plan, revalidate all nights, release the room and return to a repriced hold.

function.name: assign_room
function.description: Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: unassign_room
function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description: Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: refund_reservation
function.description: Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.name: mark_room_clean
function.description: Housekeeping or manager marks an unoccupied room clean. An occupied room cannot be cleaned through this operation.

function.name: set_room_maintenance
function.description: Manager locks/unlocks a room for maintenance. Locking cannot invalidate existing assignments or room-type bookings.

function.name: check_in
function.description: Front desk/manager checks in a confirmed booking within its dates, with room assignment, full payment and independent guest identity verification.

function.name: swap_room
function.description: Atomically move a checked-in stay to another clean available room of the same type/property; release old occupancy, dirty old room, update assignment and stay.

function.name: check_out
function.description: Check out an occupied stay, release assignment/date inventory, clear current room stay and mark the room dirty.

function.name: change_calendar_limit
function.description: Manager changes the sale limit of a resource calendar-day ID, bounded by physical type rooms and existing bookings.

function.name: set_calendar_closed
function.description: Manager closes/opens one calendar-day ID; closing is forbidden while that night has bookings or holds.

function.name: verify_guest
function.description: Front desk asks the independent identity simulator to verify the reservation guest. Do not supply an identity outcome or external attestation.

function.name: get_property
function.description: Query public property policy and configuration.

function.name: get_availability
function.description: Query public per-night capacity, held/booked counts and available inventory for the property/type/date interval.

function.name: get_room
function.description: Query scoped staff room state; a guest assigned here sees public room identification only.

function.name: get_reservation
function.description: Query a permitted reservation, quote, payments, current assignment and observed verification status.

function.name: get_guest
function.description: Query a permitted guest profile without private simulator fixtures or other booking records.

function.name: get_payment_ledger
function.description: Finance/manager or owning guest queries payments, actual balance, deposit and refundable amount.

function.name: get_calendar_day

function.name: create_hold
function.description: Create a temporary room-type booking at the resource property. Give exact dates, guest, plan, occupants, new reservation ID and hold_minutes (15/30/60). Every night must have capacity.

function.name: capture_payment
function.description: Simulate an integer-cent payment on the reservation. card_approved succeeds and card_declined fails. Same key/value retry is idempotent.

function.name: confirm_reservation
function.description: Confirm a valid unexpired hold after its quoted deposit is successfully paid.

function.name: release_hold
function.description: Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.name: expire_hold
function.description: Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.name: change_dates
function.description: Revalidate the entire new interval, release old room assignment and return the booking to a repriced hold requiring reconfirmation.

function.name: change_room_type
function.description: Upgrade/downgrade an unoccupied booking to a permitted type/plan, revalidate all nights, release the room and return to a repriced hold.

function.name: assign_room
function.description: Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: unassign_room
function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description: Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: refund_reservation
function.description: Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.name: mark_room_clean
function.description: Housekeeping or manager marks an unoccupied room clean. An occupied room cannot be cleaned through this operation.

function.name: set_room_maintenance
function.description: Manager locks/unlocks a room for maintenance. Locking cannot invalidate existing assignments or room-type bookings.

function.name: check_in
function.description: Front desk/manager checks in a confirmed booking within its dates, with room assignment, full payment and independent guest identity verification.

function.name: swap_room
function.description: Atomically move a checked-in stay to another clean available room of the same type/property; release old occupancy, dirty old room, update assignment and stay.

function.name: check_out
function.description: Check out an occupied stay, release assignment/date inventory, clear current room stay and mark the room dirty.

function.name: change_calendar_limit
function.description: Manager changes the sale limit of a resource calendar-day ID, bounded by physical type rooms and existing bookings.

function.name: set_calendar_closed
function.description: Manager closes/opens one calendar-day ID; closing is forbidden while that night has bookings or holds.

function.name: verify_guest
function.description: Front desk asks the independent identity simulator to verify the reservation guest. Do not supply an identity outcome or external attestation.

function.name: get_property
function.description: Query public property policy and configuration.

function.name: get_availability
function.description: Query public per-night capacity, held/booked counts and available inventory for the property/type/date interval.

function.name: get_room
function.description: Query scoped staff room state; a guest assigned here sees public room identification only.

function.name: get_reservation
function.description: Query a permitted reservation, quote, payments, current assignment and observed verification status.

function.name: create_hold
function.description: Create a temporary room-type booking at the resource property. Give exact dates, guest, plan, occupants, new reservation ID and hold_minutes (15/30/60). Every night must have capacity.

function.name: capture_payment
function.description: Simulate an integer-cent payment on the reservation. card_approved succeeds and card_declined fails. Same key/value retry is idempotent.

function.name: confirm_reservation
function.description: Confirm a valid unexpired hold after its quoted deposit is successfully paid.

function.name: release_hold
function.description: Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.name: expire_hold
function.description: Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.name: change_dates
function.description: Revalidate the entire new interval, release old room assignment and return the booking to a repriced hold requiring reconfirmation.

function.name: change_room_type
function.description: Upgrade/downgrade an unoccupied booking to a permitted type/plan, revalidate all nights, release the room and return to a repriced hold.

function.name: assign_room
function.description: Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: unassign_room
function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description: Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: refund_reservation
function.description: Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.name: mark_room_clean
function.description: Housekeeping or manager marks an unoccupied room clean. An occupied room cannot be cleaned through this operation.

function.name: set_room_maintenance
function.description: Manager locks/unlocks a room for maintenance. Locking cannot invalidate existing assignments or room-type bookings.

function.name: check_in
function.description: Front desk/manager checks in a confirmed booking within its dates, with room assignment, full payment and independent guest identity verification.

function.name: swap_room
function.description: Atomically move a checked-in stay to another clean available room of the same type/property; release old occupancy, dirty old room, update assignment and stay.

function.name: check_out
function.description: Check out an occupied stay, release assignment/date inventory, clear current room stay and mark the room dirty.

function.name: change_calendar_limit
function.description: Manager changes the sale limit of a resource calendar-day ID, bounded by physical type rooms and existing bookings.

function.name: set_calendar_closed
function.description: Manager closes/opens one calendar-day ID; closing is forbidden while that night has bookings or holds.

function.name: verify_guest
function.description: Front desk asks the independent identity simulator to verify the reservation guest. Do not supply an identity outcome or external attestation.

function.name: get_property
function.description: Query public property policy and configuration.

function.name: get_availability
function.description: Query public per-night capacity, held/booked counts and available inventory for the property/type/date interval.

function.name: get_room
function.description: Query scoped staff room state; a guest assigned here sees public room identification only.

function.name: get_reservation
function.description: Query a permitted reservation, quote, payments, current assignment and observed verification status.

function.name: get_guest
function.description: Query a permitted guest profile without private simulator fixtures or other booking records.

function.name: get_payment_ledger
function.description: Finance/manager or owning guest queries payments, actual balance, deposit and refundable amount.

function.name: get_calendar_day
function.description: Staff query one scoped date inventory control.

function.name: get_rate_plan
function.description: Query public deposit and cancellation policy for a property rate plan.

function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.description: Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.name: check_in

function.name: swap_room

function.name: check_out

function.name: change_calendar_limit

function.description: Create a temporary room-type booking at the resource property. Give exact dates, guest, plan, occupants, new reservation ID and hold_minutes (15/30/60). Every night must have capacity.

function.name: capture_payment
function.description: Simulate an integer-cent payment on the reservation. card_approved succeeds and card_declined fails. Same key/value retry is idempotent.

function.name: confirm_reservation
function.description: Confirm a valid unexpired hold after its quoted deposit is successfully paid.

function.name: release_hold
function.description: Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.name: expire_hold
function.description: Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.name: change_dates
function.description: Revalidate the entire new interval, release old room assignment and return the booking to a repriced hold requiring reconfirmation.

function.name: change_room_type
function.description: Upgrade/downgrade an unoccupied booking to a permitted type/plan, revalidate all nights, release the room and return to a repriced hold.

function.name: assign_room
function.description: Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: unassign_room
function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description: Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: refund_reservation
function.description: Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.name: mark_room_clean
function.description: Housekeeping or manager marks an unoccupied room clean. An occupied room cannot be cleaned through this operation.

function.name: set_room_maintenance
function.description: Manager locks/unlocks a room for maintenance. Locking cannot invalidate existing assignments or room-type bookings.

function.name: check_in
function.description: Front desk/manager checks in a confirmed booking within its dates, with room assignment, full payment and independent guest identity verification.

function.name: swap_room
function.description: Atomically move a checked-in stay to another clean available room of the same type/property; release old occupancy, dirty old room, update assignment and stay.

function.name: check_out
function.description: Check out an occupied stay, release assignment/date inventory, clear current room stay and mark the room dirty.

function.name: change_calendar_limit
function.description: Manager changes the sale limit of a resource calendar-day ID, bounded by physical type rooms and existing bookings.

function.name: set_calendar_closed
function.description: Manager closes/opens one calendar-day ID; closing is forbidden while that night has bookings or holds.

function.name: verify_guest
function.description: Front desk asks the independent identity simulator to verify the reservation guest. Do not supply an identity outcome or external attestation.

function.name: get_property
function.description: Query public property policy and configuration.

function.name: get_availability
function.description: Query public per-night capacity, held/booked counts and available inventory for the property/type/date interval.

function.name: get_room
function.description: Query scoped staff room state; a guest assigned here sees public room identification only.

function.name: get_reservation
function.description: Query a permitted reservation, quote, payments, current assignment and observed verification status.

function.name: get_guest
function.description: Query a permitted guest profile without private simulator fixtures or other booking records.

function.name: get_payment_ledger
function.description: Finance/manager or owning guest queries payments, actual balance, deposit and refundable amount.

function.name: get_calendar_day
function.description: Staff query one scoped date inventory control.

function.name: get_rate_plan
function.description: Query public deposit and cancellation policy for a property rate plan.

function.name: get_customer_context
function.description: Discover public property catalog and scoped room, guest, reservation and financial records for the fixed identity.

function.name: create_hold
function.description: Create a temporary room-type booking at the resource property. Give exact dates, guest, plan, occupants, new reservation ID and hold_minutes (15/30/60). Every night must have capacity.

function.name: capture_payment
function.description: Simulate an integer-cent payment on the reservation. card_approved succeeds and card_declined fails. Same key/value retry is idempotent.

function.name: confirm_reservation
function.description: Confirm a valid unexpired hold after its quoted deposit is successfully paid.

function.name: release_hold
function.description: Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.name: expire_hold
function.description: Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.name: change_dates
function.description: Revalidate the entire new interval, release old room assignment and return the booking to a repriced hold requiring reconfirmation.

function.name: change_room_type
function.description: Upgrade/downgrade an unoccupied booking to a permitted type/plan, revalidate all nights, release the room and return to a repriced hold.

function.name: assign_room
function.description: Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: unassign_room
function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description: Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: refund_reservation
function.description: Refund with an immutable key, bounded by actual paid balance less cancellation fees or real active-booking overpayment.

function.name: mark_room_clean
function.description: Housekeeping or manager marks an unoccupied room clean. An occupied room cannot be cleaned through this operation.

function.name: set_room_maintenance
function.description: Manager locks/unlocks a room for maintenance. Locking cannot invalidate existing assignments or room-type bookings.

function.name: check_in
function.description: Front desk/manager checks in a confirmed booking within its dates, with room assignment, full payment and independent guest identity verification.

function.name: swap_room
function.description: Atomically move a checked-in stay to another clean available room of the same type/property; release old occupancy, dirty old room, update assignment and stay.

function.name: check_out
function.description: Check out an occupied stay, release assignment/date inventory, clear current room stay and mark the room dirty.

function.name: change_calendar_limit
function.description: Manager changes the sale limit of a resource calendar-day ID, bounded by physical type rooms and existing bookings.

function.name: set_calendar_closed

function.name: release_hold
function.description: Release a temporary hold without a cancellation fee, explicitly freeing all date inventory.

function.description: Explicitly expire a hold only when the frozen clock reaches its expiry, freeing all date inventory. No tool advances time.

function.name: assign_room
function.description: Assign a clean, nonmaintenance room of the confirmed booking type without overlapping another active assignment.

function.name: unassign_room
function.description: Release a confirmed booking room assignment before check-in while retaining type inventory and deposit.

function.name: cancel_reservation
function.description: Cancel a confirmed booking, release date inventory and assignment, record its frozen-time rate-plan fee. Use release_hold for tentative bookings.

function.name: refund_reservation

function.name: check_in
function.description: Front desk/manager checks in a confirmed booking within its dates, with room assignment, full payment and independent guest identity verification.

function.name: swap_room

function.name: check_out
function.description: Check out an occupied stay, release assignment/date inventory, clear current room stay and mark the room dirty.

function.name: change_calendar_limit

function.name: set_calendar_closed
